name: Audience growth chart card
what: Rows of glossy glass spheres fill the bottom of a dark page like an audience, a dark chart card rises from behind them with a soft glowing beam, a thin line is drawn across it, the title rises into place word by word and a light travels round the card's edge before the card starts to lift away.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f24 the chart card rises from behind the spheres (slow start, quick middle, long soft finish); f8-f68 the line is drawn across the card; f42 and f49 the two title words rise into place from about 60 px below, fading in, each settling over about 27 f; f30-f97 a light travels round the card edge; f90-f97 the card starts to lift away, faster and faster (the clip stops there)
